title: The Wise Man's Fear
author: Patrick Rothfuss
summary: The second day of an innkeeper's tale continues the story of a gifted young man's rise from a poor student to a famed figure. He travels beyond the university, serves a noble patron and learns from unusual teachers.
readIf: you want more of the first book's lyrical, meandering storytelling and its charismatic narrator.
skipIf: you want plot to move forward, because it wanders and the series is still unfinished.

pairings.reason: The first book, which you should read before this one.
Another charismatic, cocky hero told with relish, with a faster, funnier plot.
A first-person fantasy with a similar intimate voice, though far sadder and more restrained.
